name: flags-admin
title: A screen for admins to switch features on and off
pitch: Admins should have a simple screen that lists every feature switch in the app, shows whether each one is on, and lets them flip it. Nobody else should be able to open that screen.

comments.author: octo-operator
comments.text: It must be impossible for a member who isn't an admin to reach it, even by typing the address.
